dev-01-rain-portrait-ko/composition.text:
Photographic role: eye-level frontal framing keeps a waiting woman's face, umbrella-holding hand and bus shelter visible together, giving the person priority over street reflections
Scene context: A woman waits with an umbrella at a rainy bus stop.

dev-01-rain-portrait-ko/lighting.text:
Photographic role: soft overcast daylight keeps the face and hands beneath an umbrella readable while preserving the wet street atmosphere
Scene context: A woman waits under an umbrella beside wet pavement.

dev-01-rain-portrait-ko/texture.text:
Photographic role: separate raindrops on the umbrella surface contrast with the wet pavement surface
Scene context: An umbrella and pavement in a rainy street.

dev-02-blue-cup-en/composition.text:
Photographic role: quiet still-life framing uses negative space around a single teacup while keeping its handle, rim and circular opening distinguishable together
Scene context: One blue porcelain teacup on a dark kitchen counter.

dev-04-small-bird-ko/lighting.text:
Photographic role: soft daylight reveals fine feather edges and the bird's feet touching grass together
Scene context: A small bird has landed on grass with folded wings.

dev-08-fashion-en/composition.text:
Photographic role: intimate fashion framing keeps the seated model, satin dress folds and ankle boot outlines visible in the same frame
Scene context: An adult model sits by a studio window in a black satin dress and ankle boots.

holdout-01-graduation-ko/body_pose.text:
Photographic role: a stable standing pose with both feet on paving and both hands supporting a bouquet at waist height
Scene context: One adult graduate stands holding a flower bouquet.

holdout-02-workshop-en/action.text:
Photographic role: one person places a shared carving tool within a partner's reach while the partner steadies a wood block on the bench
Scene context: Two adults cooperate during a woodcraft lesson.

holdout-02-workshop-en/lighting.text:
Photographic role: soft light from a high window illuminates working hands, wood grain and fresh shavings on a bench
Scene context: Hands share carving tools during a workshop lesson.

holdout-04-eclipse-ko/action.text:
Photographic role: two people wait together while directing their gaze toward the same area of sky
Scene context: Two adults await an eclipse in an open field.

holdout-11-neutral-fashion-en/body_pose.text:
Photographic role: natural standing with both feet on the floor and arms hanging beside the jacket so its sleeves and shape remain visible
Scene context: An adult model stands in a green cotton jacket.

holdout-11-neutral-fashion-en/texture.text:
Photographic role: distinct woven cotton texture and stitched seams on the surface of a green jacket
Scene context: A neutral fashion material study of a cotton jacket.
